spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (ज्यवते)
1 To advise or instruct.
2 To order.
3 To observe a vow or any religious obligation.

n. (-स्त्रं)
The science of Astronomy.
E.
ज्योतिस्, and शास्त्र a scripture.

n. (-ङ्गं)
A fire fly.
E.
ज्योतिस् light, इगि to go, affix क; also with युच् affix, ज्योतिरिङ्गण n. (-णं).

m. (-णः)
The heavenly bodies collectively.
E.
ज्योतिम् a planet, and गण a class.

m. (-त्)
An astrologer, an arithmetician.
E.
ज्योतिस्, and विद् who knows.

f. (-द्या)
The science of computation, from arithmetic to astronomy and astrology.
E.
ज्योतिस्, and विद्या science.

n. (-जं)
A fire fly.
E.
ज्योतिस् light, and वीज seed.

n. (-क्रं)
1 The zodiac.
2 The lunar mansion.
E.
ज्योतिस् planet, and चक्र a sphere.

mfn. (-षः-षी-षं)
Astrological, astronomical, relating to the heavenly bodies.
mf. (-षः-षी)
An astrologer.
n. (-षं)
Mathematical, astronomical, and astrological science, astronomy, astrology.
f. (-षी)
A star, a planet, an asterism.
E.
ज्योतिस् light, especially of the heavenly bodies, affix अण्, fem. ङीष्

m. (-कः)
An astrologer: see ज्यौतिषिक.

m. (-ष्कः)
1 A planetary or heavenly body; the generic term for the sun, the moon, a planet, an asterism, a star: the word in the m. plu. (-ष्काः) implies all these five.
2 A tree, the wood of which is used to produce fire by attrition: see गणिकारिका.
f. (-का)
Heart-pea: see ज्योतिष्मती.
E.
ज्योतिस् light, and क what makes, from कृ, with ड aff.

mfn. (-ल्पः-ल्पा-ल्पं)
Blazing, radiant, like flame or fire.
E.
ज्योतिस्, and कल्प affix, implying resemblance.

n. (-मं)
A particular sacrifice at which sixteen officiating priests are required.
E.
ज्योतिस् light, and स्तोम a sacrifice.

m. (-मान्)
The sun.
f. (-मती)
Heart-pea, (Halicacabum cardiospermum.)
E.
ज्योतिस् light or splendor, and मतुप् poss. aff.

Light.
2

A star.
3 The pupil of the eye.
m. (-तिः)
1 The sun.
2 AGNI or fire.
E.
द्युत् to shine, to be or give light, इसिन् Uṇādi affix, and ज substituted for the radical initial.

ind.
In flame or fire.
E.
ज्योतिस्, and साति aff.

m. (-थः)
The pole star, or in mythology DHRUVA, the son of UTTĀNAPĀDA.
E.
ज्योतिस् a star, and रथ a vehicle.

Moonlight.
2

A moonlight night.
3 A small cucumber: see ज्योत्स्नी.
E.
ज्योतिस् light, त affix, and the penultimate rejected deriv. irr. fem. affix टाप्; also with ङीप्^1, ज्योत्स्नी q. v.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161212. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batches 309-312.

m. (-यः)
The Cakora or Greek partridge.
E.
ज्योत्स्ना moonlight, and प्रिय fond of; this bird is said to feed upon the moonbeams.

m. (-क्षः)
The tripod or tree of a lampstand, a candlestick.
E.
ज्योत्स्ना moonlight, (put for lamp-light,) and वृक्ष a tree.

f. (-त्स्नी)
1 A moonlight night.
2 A small cucumber, (Trichosanthes diæca); it is also applied to Luffa acutangula, &c.
3 A kind of perfume: see रेणुका.
E.
see ज्योत्स्ना.
